scenario: Two people in a romantic relationship are on a vacation
learner_goal: Share bed and sleep together (<extra_info>Extra information: you have been sharing the bed for a few nights but the other person is not sleeping well</extra_info>)
partner_goal: Sleep in a separate bed to get a good night's sleep but also maintain the intimacy with your partner (<extra_info>Extra information: you have been experiencing back pain and needs a firmer mattress to sleep on.</extra_info>)

transcript.speaker: Ethan Johnson
transcript.content: Hey Esmeralda — I’ve noticed you haven’t been sleeping well the past few nights. If you’d like, I can make some chamomile, keep the room cool and quiet, and lie with you until you drift off — I can hold you, or we can try sleeping back-to-back, whatever feels safest and most comfortable for you. What would help you sleep tonight?

transcript.speaker: Esmeralda Solis
transcript.content: You’re so thoughtful, Ethan — thank you. My back’s been acting up and I really sleep better on a firmer mattress, so I think I’ll take the other bed tonight so I actually get some rest. Could we still do chamomile together on the balcony/sofa and have a few minutes of closeness — a shoulder rub or a quick kiss goodnight — and then I’ll head to the firmer bed? I love you, and this is just so I don’t wake up sore; we can save the close hold for our next tango.

transcript.speaker: Ethan Johnson
transcript.content: Absolutely — give me five minutes. I’ll make chamomile and bring it out to the balcony/sofa, give you a slow shoulder rub and a quick kiss goodnight. I’ll grab a firmer pillow or a folded blanket to support your back tonight. I love you.

transcript.speaker: Esmeralda Solis
transcript.content: Perfect — thank you, Ethan. I’ll meet you on the balcony in five. Chamomile and a slow shoulder rub sound heavenly; a quick kiss goodnight is perfect. Save the close hold for our next tango. I love you — this will help me actually sleep. See you out there.

transcript.speaker: Ethan Johnson
transcript.content: Heading out now — the chamomile is steeping and I’ll bring the firmer pillow and a folded blanket. I’ll meet you on the balcony in five for tea, a slow shoulder rub, and that quick kiss goodnight. Love you.

transcript.speaker: Esmeralda Solis
transcript.content: On my way — I’ll be on the balcony in a minute. Looking forward to the chamomile, your slow shoulder rub, and that quick kiss goodnight. I love you.

transcript.speaker: Ethan Johnson
transcript.content: I’m here — chamomile, the firmer pillow, and the blanket. Come sit with me on the balcony sofa; I’ll give you that slow shoulder rub and a quick kiss goodnight when you’re ready. I love you.

transcript.speaker: Esmeralda Solis
transcript.content: This is perfect — the chamomile smells wonderful. I’ll sit beside you on the sofa and lean into that slow shoulder rub; a quick kiss goodnight will be lovely. After a little tea and closeness I’ll head to the other bed with the firmer pillow and blanket so my back can rest. I love you.
